title: plectranthus barbatus var. grandis
intro: Plectranthus barbatus var. grandis, commonly known as Coleus forskohlii, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of Coleus forskohlii include its ability to stimulate the production of cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP), which has a positive effect on various bodily processes, such as increasing lipolysis and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Coleus forskohlii include forskolin, a labdane diterpene that is responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds like phenolic acids and flavonoids.
